title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Local Peer Proof Harness Work Item
summary: Add a repeatable local-loopback peer proof for the RFC 9220 WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 tunnel surface.
planned_changes:
- Add an aggregate HTTP/3 loopback test that opens a client WebSocket tunnel through the public client/server APIs.
- Exercise accepted response metadata, server ping with client pong helper behavior, text exchange, buffered binary exchange, client close, and server close echo in one peer-style flow.
- Add a proof script that stores TRX/stdout/stderr plus JSON and Markdown manifests under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-local-peer/<run-id>`.
verification_plan: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/proofs/Invoke-Rfc9220WebSocketLocalPeerProof.ps1 -RunId <run-id>`, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage when trace artifacts change, focused WebSocket tests, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Production proxy target, timeout, authorization, or deployment policy.
New RFC 9220 requirement ownership beyond the already trace-owned behavior.
completion_notes: The local-loopback peer proof passed under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-local-peer/20260619T0124Z-local-peer` and remains explicitly narrower than external peer proof.
